summary.en: While on a walk, Conan, Ran, and Kogoro heard a gunshot from a house in Kamakura. While heading to investigate, Kogoro was unable to catch a masked man that runs past them. Conan finds a dead man with dried blood and white powdery substance on his shirt.

suspects: Rokuro Yaguchi, Akihiko Yaguchi, and Kimio Yaguchi
suspectsZh: 矢口六郎、矢口昭彦与矢口君夫
